//: PROPOSED. Never applied to any account. The run-once migrator task: database, and nothing else.

Statement.//: Its only secret. A migrator that could read the object-store credentials would be a second identity holding them for no reason.

A migration is DDL against one database. It has no reason to touch the evidence store, the queue or a model, and a migrator with those permissions is a highly-privileged task that runs unattended on every deploy.
